recognize_zh: 淋巴結 H&E 2 倍低倍：結構保留，可見多個小而萎縮的濾泡，部分生發中心淡染或呈粉紅玻璃樣變，套區邊界不清，濾泡間區明顯擴大且呈粉紫色，右側門部血管增生，這種低倍型態提示多中心 Castleman 病。
features: Preserved nodal architecture with multiple small, widely spaced follicles
Regressed germinal centers, some with pale eosinophilic hyalinized centers
Markedly expanded interfollicular areas with a pink-purple cellular infiltrate (plasma cells at higher power)
Prominent vessels and fibrous tissue at the hilum/capsule on the right; artifactual cracks in section
describe_en: Lymph node section (H&E, 2x) shows preserved architecture with multiple small, widely spaced follicles containing regressed germinal centers, some with central hyalinization, and poorly delineated mantle zones. The interfollicular areas are markedly expanded by a dense cellular infiltrate, which at higher power comprises sheets of mature plasma cells, accompanied by prominent vascularity at the hilum. Individual cell morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification, and sectioning artifact (cracks) is present. Findings are consistent with the plasma cell pattern of multicentric Castleman disease; HHV8 (LANA-1) immunostaining is required for classification.

ddx.vs: iMCD shows similar regressed follicles and interfollicular plasmacytosis but lacks LANA-1-positive plasmablasts.

ddx.dx: Nodal involvement by plasma cell neoplasm
ddx.vs: Plasmacytoma effaces architecture with monotypic plasma cells, whereas here follicles are preserved and plasma cells are interfollicular.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymphadenopathy in autoimmune disease or HIV
ddx.vs: Reactive nodes usually show hyperplastic germinal centers with tingible body macrophages rather than regressed, hyalinized follicles.
AITL shows effaced architecture with arborizing high endothelial venules, expanded FDC meshworks and clear-cell atypical TFH cells (CD10/PD1+), not preserved follicles.
